correctness.rationale: Disjoint center-in/out cases give a bijective monomial enumeration, verified against the original private-neighbor definition on all 25 small parameter pairs. For a>=1, each log-concavity difference is p t^2+q t+r with t=a+1>=2 and p,r>=0. The finite exact certificate checks for every b=0..43 and every k the universally sufficient condition q>=0 or q^2<=4pr. For a=0 the b+1 nonzero coefficients are directly checked. At b=44 and a=2^24-1, explicit adjacent coefficients have strictly negative log-concavity difference 21; all integer computations independently re-executed. No finite graph enumeration is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: A complete coefficient enumeration and a sharp parameter threshold for log-concavity are natural structural invariants of a broad, elementary two-parameter tree family. The first counterexample is a motivated boundary to coefficient-shape behavior, not an arbitrary sequence sample. The 44 threshold is certified uniformly over every value of the unbounded other parameter, and identifies a genuine transition between all-instance validity and possible failure.
